paite: Pathian aw, hon hehpih inla, hon hehpih in; ka hinna nangmah ah ahong puklut ngal a, ahi, na khalim nuai ah ka bu ding, vangtahnate athen masiah.
heading: David La / Panpihna Dia Thumna Saul Kiang A Kipan Kokhuk A Ataimang Lai
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

paite: Pathian Tungnungpen ka sam ding, Pathian kei dia bangkim hon hihsakpa.
english: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

paite: Hon valh khit tumpa'n ahon gensiat hun chiang in ama'n van a kipan in ahon sawl ding a, ahon hondam ding hi;Selah Pathian in azahngaihna leh athutak ahon sawlkhe ding.
english: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

paite: Ka hinna humpinelkai lak ah a-om a; mi mei a kang lak ah ka lum a, mihing tate lak ah; huaite ha tei leh thal ahi a, alei uh namsau hiamtak ahi.
english: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

paite: Pathian aw, nang van khen pek ah pahtawi in hong om in! Na thupina leitung tengteng tung ah hong om hen!
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

paite: Ka khe awkna ding in len aphah ua; ka hinna akun kheikhei a, ka ma ah kokhuk atou ua; amau mah alaitak ah akia uhi. Selah
english: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

paite: Ka lungtang akip ahi, Pathian aw, ka lungtang akip ahi; la ka sa ding a, ahi, phatna la ka sa ding hi.
english: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

paite: Ka thupina, halh in; pekging leh kaihgingte aw, halh un; kei zingkhang in ka halh ding hi.
english: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

paite: TOUPA aw, michih lak ah nang kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a, namte lak ah nangmah phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

paite: Na zahngaihna vante sun in athupi a, na thutak meipite sun in athupi ahi.
english: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

paite: Pathian aw, nang vante khen pek ah pahtawi in omta in; na thupina leitung tengteng ah hong omta hen.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
